blocks.text: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, this is {{caller.first_name}} with WCM. {{ai.opener}}

blocks.label: Yes, looking for more patients
blocks.text: Great, that is exactly what we do for clinics like {{contact.company_name}}. {{ai.hook}}

blocks.label: At capacity / too busy
blocks.text: Totally fair. Most of our best clients said the same before they added {{field.contact.goal_new_patients}} new patients a month on autopilot.

blocks.label: What do you do?
blocks.text: We run patient-acquisition ads and follow-up for wellness clinics: med spas, IV therapy, weight loss, HRT and chiropractic. {{ai.hook}}

blocks.label: Do you sell leads?
blocks.text: No. We never sell shared leads. Everything we generate for {{contact.company_name}} is exclusive to you.

blocks.label: Not interested – timing
blocks.text: Understood. When would be a better time: is it a budget cycle thing or just a busy season in {{contact.city}}?

blocks.label: Not interested – firm
blocks.text: No problem, I will not take more of your time. Thanks {{contact.first_name}}.

blocks.label: Busy / with a patient
blocks.text: Totally understand, I'll be quick. What's a better time today or tomorrow, and is this the best number or would email be easier?

blocks.label: Who is this? What company?
blocks.text: Wellness Clinic Marketing. We're a marketing company that works only with HRT and weight-loss clinics, helping them bring in more cash-pay patients.

blocks.label: How much does it cost?
blocks.text: Fair question. It depends on the clinic's size, services and how long you've been in business. Our strategist gives exact numbers in a 15-minute call. Can I ask two quick questions so he comes prepared?

blocks.label: Didn't see your email
blocks.text: No problem. It's a short review of your website: what's working and a few gaps in local visibility. I'll resend it now. What's the best email for you?

blocks.label: Already have an agency
blocks.text: Good to hear. We only focus on HRT and weight loss. Who handles it for you now, and is there anything that isn't covered yet?
Quick question so I point you to the right next step: {{ai.qualifier}}
Don't say SEO or ads. Lead with patient bookings.

blocks.label: Owner does it
blocks.text: Got it, so it lives on your plate on top of running {{contact.company_name}}. How many hours a week does that eat up?

blocks.label: Agency – happy
blocks.text: Great, glad that is working. Are they driving actual booked appointments or mostly likes and clicks?

blocks.label: Agency – frustrated
blocks.text: You are not alone. That is the number one reason clinics switch to us. What is the most frustrating part?

blocks.label: Nobody
blocks.text: So growth is all word of mouth right now. How many new patients are you getting a month?

blocks.label: Owner not available (gatekeeper)
blocks.text: No problem. Who handles marketing decisions, and what's the best email and time to reach them?

blocks.label: Not a clinic / wrong person
blocks.text: Thanks for letting me know, sorry to bother you. Do you know a clinic owner who might want more HRT or weight-loss patients?

blocks.label: What type of practice is this?
How many locations do you have?
How many new patients per month today?
Where do patients come from today?

blocks.sayItBack: So just to confirm, {{contact.company_name}} is doing {{field.contact.monthly_new_patients}} new patients a month at {{field.contact.avg_patient_value}} each, so about {{computed.current_revenue}} a month, and you want to get to {{field.contact.goal_new_patients}} new patients, which is {{computed.target_revenue}}. Did I get that right?

blocks.text: If that sounds right, the next step is a 20-minute Zoom where we map exactly how we would fill that gap for {{contact.company_name}}. {{ai.booking_push}}
If they refuse Zoom: offer the audit report instead, then book a callback. Never just hang up.

items.a: We run Meta and Google ads plus automated follow-up that turn clicks into booked appointments for wellness clinics. You only talk to patients who already booked.
No agency can ethically guarantee patients. We guarantee the system: targeted ads, same-day follow-up, and a show-up process, and we track cost per booked appointment with you weekly.
Great, are they booking you measurable appointments each month, or reporting clicks? We can run a free audit against what they do so you can compare apples to apples.
Happy to. What would be most useful, the audit of {{contact.company_name}} or client results? And what is the best email?

items.q: Can we do a phone call instead of Zoom?
items.a: We can, but Zoom lets us screen-share your numbers and the plan. It is 20 minutes and most owners find it 10x more useful. Morning or afternoon better?

items.q: How did you get my info?
items.a: Your clinic is listed publicly in {{contact.city}} and caught our eye because {{ai.opener}} Happy to remove you if you prefer.

items.q: I never contacted you. Why are you calling?
items.a: No problem. You may have reached us through a social media ad or form. Are you the owner or manager of a clinic?
Only wellness clinics: HRT, weight loss, med spas and similar cash-pay practices.

items.q: Do you have a referral or affiliate program?
items.a: Yes. Our strategist can walk you through the details on the call.

items: Wants to buy leads only, not a marketing partner
Happy and locked in with current vendor long-term
Won't share basic business info (patients, revenue, goals)
Brand-new clinic with no patients, website or Google profile yet

options.label: Under 10
options.say: That's very doable. A lot of clinics start right there.

options.label: HRT
options.say: HRT is one of our strongest areas. Is it mostly men, women, or both?

options.label: Weight loss
options.say: Weight loss is in high demand right now. Are you running a medical program today?

options.label: Something else
options.say: Tell me a bit about it so our strategist comes prepared.

next.ask: Which service would you want those patients for?

options.label: 10 to 30
options.say: A solid goal for {{contact.company_name}}. A strategist can map it out in 15 minutes.

options.label: Referrals / word of mouth
options.say: Good base. Referrals are hard to scale, so we add steady new patients on top.

options.label: Google / website
options.say: Then your site and local listings matter a lot. Our review shows where you're losing visibility.

options.label: Social media / ads
options.say: Got it. Who runs those for you, someone in-house or an agency?

options.label: Not sure / not tracking
options.say: Very common. The first step is tracking where each new patient comes from.

next.ask: Where do most of your new patients come from today?

options.label: More than 30
options.say: Ambitious, I like it.

options.label: Yes, we have room
options.say: Perfect, then it's only about getting them in the door. Let's get you with the strategist.

options.label: We'd need to hire
options.say: Good to know. We'd pace the volume to your capacity.

next.ask: Do you have room to see them?

options.label: No set number
options.say: No problem. What would a good month look like compared to now?

r-looking.ask: Roughly how many new patients a month would you like to add?

options.label: We keep a waitlist
options.say: Smart. We can keep that list warm automatically so nobody drifts away.

options.label: We turn them away
options.say: That's lost revenue. Would filling slower days or one service help?

options.label: It's temporary, we're hiring
options.say: Understood. Lining up demand ahead of new capacity can save you months.

options.label: We're fine as we are
options.say: Fair enough. Is there one service you'd like to grow even so?

r-capacity.ask: When you're full, what happens to new inquiries?

options.label: Yes
options.say: Perfect, that's our focus. Which one brings in more today?

options.label: Other services
options.say: We also work with med spas and chiropractic. Which service drives most of your revenue?

options.label: Not sure / not the owner
options.say: No problem. Who handles marketing there, and when is a good time to reach them?

r-what.ask: Are you taking on new HRT or weight-loss patients right now?

options.label: Yes, and they were poor
options.say: That's exactly why we don't sell them. Everything we generate is exclusive to you.

options.label: No
options.say: Good. Nothing we generate is resold, it's all for your clinic.

options.label: Not sure
options.say: Shared leads go to several clinics at once. Ours go only to you.

r-leads.ask: Have you bought shared leads before?

options.label: Busy season
options.say: Understood. What day and time should I check back?

options.label: This number
options.say: Great, I'll call then.

options.label: Email
options.say: Perfect. What's the best email?

next.ask: Is this the best number, or would email be easier?

options.label: Budget cycle
options.say: Makes sense. When does the next budget get set? I'll follow up then.

options.label: Just not now
options.say: Fair. Can I send a short website review so you have it when the timing is right?

options.label: Yes, send it
options.say: Great. What's the best email for it?

options.label: No thanks
options.say: No problem, thanks for your time.

r-timing.ask: Is it a busy season or a budget thing?

options.label: Later today
options.say: Perfect. What time?

options.label: Tomorrow
options.say: Great. Morning or afternoon?

options.label: Next week
options.say: No problem. Which day works best?

r-new-4-1.ask: What time works for a quick call back?

options.label: Sure
options.say: How long have you been in business, and how many locations do you have?

options.label: Just tell me the price
options.say: I don't want to guess and get it wrong. The strategist gives exact numbers in 15 minutes. Can we set that up?

options.label: No, not interested
options.say: No problem, thanks for your time.

r-new-4-3.ask: Can I ask two quick questions so the strategist comes prepared?

options.label: Yes
options.say: Done, I'll send it now. Would you like 15 minutes to go over it?

options.label: A different email
options.say: What's the best one?

r-new-4-4.ask: Is this the best email to resend it to?

options.label: An agency
options.say: Good. Are they bringing in booked appointments?

options.label: In-house
options.say: Then we'd support your team rather than replace it.

options.label: Nobody really
options.say: So growth is mostly word of mouth. How many new patients a month?

r-new-4-5.ask: Who handles it for you now?

options.label: A few hours
options.say: That's time away from patients. Does it get done consistently?

options.label: Too much / falling behind
options.say: That's common. Taking this off your plate is what we do.

options.label: Almost none
options.say: Then growth has probably stalled. Is that fair?

options.label: Yes, booked appointments
options.say: Great. Do you know how many a month come from them?

options.label: Mostly clicks / not sure
options.say: That's the gap we hear most. We'd track booked patients, not clicks.

options.label: No real bookings
options.say: Booked patients is the only number that matters, and it's what we report on.

options.label: Poor communication
options.say: You should always know what's happening. The strategist will show you how we report.

options.label: Locked in a contract
options.say: Understood. When does it end? We can time the start for then.

options.label: Under 10 a month
options.say: There's room to grow. What are you aiming for?

options.label: 10 to 30
options.say: Healthy. Where do most of them come from?

options.label: More than 30
options.say: Strong. Do you have room for more?

options.label: The owner
options.say: What's the best email and time to reach them?

options.label: The office manager
options.say: May I have their name and email?

options.label: Not sure
options.say: No problem. What time is the owner usually available?

options.say: Great. Who is it, and how can I reach them?

options.say: No problem, thanks for your time.
